title: Our biggest questions heading into training camp
channel_name: The Athletic Football Show: A show about the NFL
text: *GENERIC TRUMPET BLASTS SOUNDING A CALL TO ARMS* That's right, training camp is here and the 2026 NFL season is basically underway. We have plenty of questions around the league as all 32 teams open camp across the next few days, so many that we can't possibly get into all of them. title: [FULL EPISODE] Revisiting the questions we wanted answered before training camp
channel_name: Take The North: A Chicago Bears Podcast
text: Bears training camp is about to get fully underway! That means it's time for Dan Wiederer and Mark Grote to go back and revisit the questions we wanted the answers to before this camp got started. Did we get clarity on who will be playing left tackle? Do we see a clear vision for the rebuilt secondary? How will the pass rush be better? Do we now know the next frontier for quarterback Caleb Williams? One thing we know for sure...there will not be shovels in the ground for a new stadium before camp opens.
